newsitem.title: USA: Vitech to buy Brazil's Microtec.
newsitem.headline: Vitech to buy Brazil's Microtec.

text.p: Vitech America Inc said Tuesday it will buy Microtec Sistemas Industria e Comercio SA, a manufacturer and distributor of personal computers in Brazil, for about $14.6 million.
The company said $12 million will be paid in cash, and the balance will be paid in common stock.
The company said it expects Microtec's cost of goods to decrease "significantly" because of the deal.
Vitech said it plans to maintain its and Microtec's personal computer lines. The company said it expects the deal to close by the end of its third quarter.

Microtec's sales were about $72 million and net income was $2 million for the year ended December 31, 1996. Vitech reported sales for 1996 of $73.3 million and net income of $8.2 million, or $0.94 per share.
